description: This file defines functions and constants for generating and emitting a CLI banner for the OpenClaw project, including ASCII art, theming, and handling of command-line flags.

methods.name: splitGraphemes
methods.description: Splits a string into grapheme clusters using Intl.Segmenter if available, otherwise falls back to Array.from.

methods.name: hasJsonFlag
methods.description: Checks if the command-line arguments include '--json' or '--json='.

methods.name: hasVersionFlag
methods.description: Checks if the command-line arguments include '--version', '-V', or a root version alias.

methods.name: parseTaglineMode
methods.description: Parses a value into a TaglineMode if it matches 'random', 'default', or 'off'.

methods.name: resolveTaglineMode
methods.description: Resolves the tagline mode based on options or environment.
